scope: Fresh read-only exact-base ELF/ZIP audit for the foveal-canvas experiment. No APK installation, runtime/GPU acceptance, performance or visual-resolution proof.

originalApk.signatureVerification: Not repeated here; prior verification recorded in diagnostics/steamlink-legacy-1812-1968/input-provenance.json

nextChains.preservation: Both original FB settings next pointers and settings flags must be retained; only null or a single known FB settings node is supported. Unknown nodes/tails pass through unchanged.

sameSpaceEvidence.meaning: Both use the same context and reference-space type; lookup returns the same context-map handle.

samePoseEvidence.input: Both projection families pass the same frame pose pointer x20, with separate output view pointer x1.
samePoseEvidence.meaning: Identical helper/input proves matching pose computation in stock5001812; helper still checks actual per-frame equality before transforming.

swapchainContract.format: GL_SRGB8_ALPHA8 (0x8c43) stock; output-format patches independently guarded
swapchainContract.sampleCount: From runtime XrViewConfigurationView.recommendedSwapchainSampleCount, not statically1; canvas helper must reject unsupported counts and report them
swapchainContract.widthHeight: Stream-derived shared dimensions; independent canvas can only be validated against runtime limits
swapchainContract.imageRect: FlipFrame resets both offsets to0 and both extents to stream dimensions
swapchainContract.fovealFov: FlipFrame derives narrow FOV with tanf/atanf from frame metadata; full-eye canvas requires tangent-plane placement and full-eye submitted FOV

shaderContract.meaning: Original GL masked pass synthesizes feathered curved alpha; rendered RGBA copy retains it. Direct decoded-tile crop is not equivalent.
